system.description:
Using Foraging, a character can gather enough roots, fruit and greens from the land to feed himself in times of austerity. Usually Foraging is a day long endeavor.

Obstacles: Starvation rations, Ob 1. Feeding yourself in the wild, Ob 2. Feeding yourself near civilization, population or an army, Ob 3. Feeding yourself in wasteland, Ob 4. Feeding yourself in winter, Ob 5.

FoRKs: Hunting, Herbalism

Skill Type: Forester. Tools: No.

Root: Perception

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 273
